description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git functionality related to cherry-pick conflicts, rerere (reuse recorded resolution), and related behaviors within the testing framework.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with specified message and files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files and checks if they are identical.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets a Git configuration parameter for testing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
